overrides.label: Category overrides
overrides.description: One entry per app as App=Category, e.g. Steam=Games or org.remmina.Remmina=Work. The app is its name or desktop id; any new category name creates its own group.

hidden.description: App names or desktop ids to leave out of the panel.
